svg.title: Cascade System - Application Diagram
svg.desc: Geothermal well → storage and heat exchange → bathing-water services, domestic hot water and building heating. English key: 自来水 = mains water; 生活热水 = domestic hot water; 温泉水 = hot-spring water; 地暖 = underfloor heating; 风机盘管 = fan coil; 热泵机组 = heat-pump unit.
svg.text: Geothermal well → storage and heat exchange → bathing-water services, domestic hot water and building heating.
English key: 自来水 = mains water; 生活热水 = domestic hot water; 温泉水 = hot-spring water; 地暖 = underfloor heating; 风机盘管
= fan coil; 热泵机组 = heat-pump unit.
